'''Nieka Haslip''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Garos IV]]. She had a [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[West Haslip|West]], and a child, [[Dair Haslip|Dair]]. In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], West and Nieka Haslip were killed by a Sundar attack, during the [[Garosian civil war]].<ref name="Turning Point" />
